args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring (and the
FIN-212 spec) calling for banker's rounding. Import and apply
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 as tested in
tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring and the spec calling for `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: `round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Behavior

- `2.675` → `2.68` (unchanged)
- `2.665` → `2.66` (was `2.67` with HALF_UP — this is the half-even case the test checks)

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passes, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
